description: This file defines several grain classes related to transaction attribution testing in Orleans. It includes implementations such as NoAttributionGrain, SuppressAttributionGrain, and others, each providing a method to retrieve nested transaction IDs by delegating to a static helper class.

classes.name: NoAttributionGrain
classes.description: Grain class that represents a non-attribution scenario, delegating transaction ID retrieval to AttributionGrain.

classes.name: SuppressAttributionGrain
classes.description: Grain class that suppresses attribution, delegating transaction ID retrieval.

classes.name: CreateOrJoinAttributionGrain
classes.description: Grain class used for create or join attribution scenarios.

classes.name: SupportedAttributionGrain
classes.description: Grain class indicating support for attribution.

classes.name: NotAllowedAttributionGrain
classes.description: Grain class indicating attribution not allowed.

classes.name: AttributionGrain
classes.description: Static helper class containing method to retrieve nested transaction IDs recursively.

methods.name: GetNestedTransactionIds
methods.description: Retrieves nested transaction IDs recursively, respecting the tier and tiers hierarchy.
